messages:
elsa (Docs): heads-up: the /events/ingest API ref shows `meta: []` in the response example but prod returns an object

sam (API): yikes. link?

elsa (Docs): https://redwood.dev/api-ref#/events/ingest -> response example block. the TS quickstart that uses `resp.meta[0]` fails type checks.

mohit (SDK): that explains the TypeScript fail I filed earlier. our client types expect `Record<string,string> | null` but the docs example made it look like `string[]`.

sam (API): looks like a docs-only regression from an older batch example. runtime has always returned an object for meta. i'll validate quickly against logs.

sam (API): confirmed: no array payloads in prod for the last 180 days. docs are wrong.

elsa (Docs): proposal: update openapi example to `meta: { request_id: "r_123", source: "uploader" }`, change the TS/JS snippets on that page to access `resp.meta.request_id`, and add a short note: "docs previously showed an array for meta; runtime uses object"

mohit (SDK): i'll patch SDK typings + add a unit test to accept both shapes and normalize in the client constructor. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/188

vivek (Infra): optional: we could add a middleware in the API to coerce array -> object to be defensive. cheap safety net if anyone accidentally emits array in future.

sam (API): SGTM. i'll open a tiny middleware PR with a test. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/1003

elsa (Docs): i'll open docs PR with the example and snippet updates and a changelog note. aiming to get this into tomorrow's docs deploy. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/436

mohit (SDK): quick note: when normalizing in client, i'll log a debug warning so customers see if they hit an unexpected shape. keeps backward compat.

elsa (Docs): thanks. can API + SDK reviewers approve quickly so we can ship docs tomorrow morning?

sam (API): will review and merge API PR today.

mohit (SDK): merged SDK PR to main and published canary 0.12.4-canary.1. updated quickstart snippet in SDK repo as well.

docbot: docs deploy scheduled by elsa for 2026-03-24T09:00:00-07:00 :calendar:

elsa (Docs): merged docs PR. verified examples on staging site and the TS quickstart runs without errors.

docbot: docs deploy completed (v2026-03-24-0900) :white_check_mark: live on staging and prod behind CDN cache TTLs.

live follow-up notes: elsa (Docs): added a small troubleshooting FAQ entry: "If your code treated meta as an array, update to object accessors or use SDK >=0.12.4-canary.1"

sam (API): updated internal spec generator to stop creating array example templates.

mohit (SDK): opened a tiny changelog item and pinged #support with example fix link.

elsa (Docs): closing loop — will keep an eye for similar shape mismatches on other endpoints. :sparkles:
